VmcErrorState
VMC sensor operation state.  NONE (0) means VMC sensor is operating healthy. NO_VCENTER_CONNECTION (1) means There is
no connection with vCenter. FAILED_CAPTURE (2) means Failed to complete inventory capture successfully.
Values:
NONE (0)
NO_VCENTER_CONNECTION (1)
FAILED_CAPTURE (2)
ErrorMessage
Description for an error.
LastCaptureId
Identifier for the last capture.
LastCaptureStartTimestamp Timestamp for the last capture start time.
LastCaptureEndTimestamp
Timestamp for the last capture end time.
